title: Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our 3rd year Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap designed to show you first-hand what it’s like to be part of a pharmacy team while gaining an overview of store, district, and regional operations. You will gain valuable hands-on experience through a training roadmap that includes a combination of Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), activities, and time spent with leaders in your district. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

3rd year Pharmacy Interns are responsible for completion of a comprehensive training roadmap, focusing on KLEs that build aptitude in the following areas. As tenure increases, 3rd year Pharmacy Interns take on increasing responsibility of the safety and effectiveness of operations in the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the 3rd year Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Accepted into, or actively enrolled in, an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist

title: .NET / DevOps Architect
description:
About the role

We are looking to bring on board a person with a solid technical foundation and a desire to work in a team that combines automation, developer support, and the evolution of technological platforms. The position has a hybrid component between advanced support, platform engineering, and the development of automations.

What you'll do

  • Participate in the evolution and maintenance of our CI/CD pipelines, creating automations that make life easier for development teams.
  • Collaborate closely with teams working in the .NET ecosystem, helping with incidents, debugging, technical decisions, and the maintenance of proprietary systems.
  • Contribute to the progressive transition towards deploying components in container-based environments, providing technical judgment, best practices, and previous experience if you have it.
  • Participate in the design of new capabilities related to AI and intelligent automation, an area that our group is going to boost.
  • Work as a team to continuously improve our platforms, tools, and processes.

What we're looking for

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in development within the .NET ecosystem (C#, .NET Framework, or .NET Core):
    • Solid knowledge of architecture, patterns, best practices, and troubleshooting.
    • Ability to understand and resolve problems in third-party applications.
  • Basic knowledge or real interest in DevOps and process automation.
  • Ability to write scripts (PowerShell, bash, python, or others).
  • Eagerness to learn, collaborate, and contribute in an environment where technologies change rapidly.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience creating or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Groovy, Jenkins, YAML, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Having worked with containers (Docker, Kubernetes, or related platforms) and real experience in application deployment or packaging.
  • Experience in the Java ecosystem, even if occasional: some systems we support use it.
  • Knowledge of or interest in AI applied to development and automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with collaborative environments and modern development tools.

What you'll get

  • Training program provided by the company so you can continue to develop and advance within the career plan that exists for you.
  • Permanent contract and stability.
  • Flexible compensation and more benefits.
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Hybrid remote work modality, although for this position 100% remote work is possible
  • Every Friday, intensive working day!
  • Intensive working day in summer!
  • We offer you a dynamic environment where your career plan and growth will be our goal.
  • Great work environment, open and inclusive.
  • You will be part of a great team of professionals with curiosity and motivation for technology.

Are you ready to take on new challenges and continue developing your professional career?

Sign up for the offer, this could be the opportunity you were waiting for!

About the company & team

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Inetum's team of 28,000 consultants and experts strives every day to make a digital impact on businesses, public sector entities, and society. Inetum's solutions aim to contribute to the performance and innovation of its clients, as well as to the general interest.

Present in 19 countries with a dense network of centers, Inetum collaborates with major software vendors to tackle the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

Driven by its ambition for growth and expansion, Inetum generated a business figure of €2.5 billion in 2023.

title: Lead Economy Designer - RPG
description:
About the role

As our first Economy Designer, you'll own how its economy works: what players earn, what things cost, and what we sell. Every decision you make shows up in retention and revenue within weeks.

You'll report to our Chief Product Officer and work with product, design, live ops, data and the studio team behind the game. You start on Harvest King, then take what you build to the rest of our RPG portfolio. You don't need a games background. You need sharp economic thinking, ownership, and the drive to prove every change with data.

  • Experience owning pricing, revenue, monetisation or an economy, in games, marketplaces, travel, fintech or similar.
  • A shipped change you can measure: the number before, the number after, and your own part.
  • Systems thinking: sources and sinks, supply and demand, and the constraint that limits the rest.
  • Hands-on modelling, with SQL and Python or similar tools.
  • Experience designing and reading A/B tests.
  • Curiosity about free-to-play games and how they make money.

What you'll do

  • Own. Run the economy of a live game end to end: currencies, rewards, sinks, pricing and offers.
  • Diagnose. Find what really holds players back, and model it, before touching any lever.
  • Balance. Get the mix of ads and in-app purchases right, so revenue grows without hurting retention.
  • Experiment. Turn hypotheses into A/B tests, read the results, and keep only what works.
  • Build with AI. Create AI tools that track economy health, flag problems and suggest the next tests.
  • Scale. Turn what works on Harvest King into a method for every RPG title we launch.
  • Shape. Drive the game's roadmap with product and design, backed by your models and data.

What we're looking for

  • Ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and do the best work of your career.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing or running a game economy, live ops or monetisation.
  • A background in economics, statistics or another quantitative field.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

What you'll get

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you'll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We're committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we'll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

About the company & team

At Homa, we're building the games a billion people will play. Games that become part of players' lives for years. A company where every person grows faster than they thought possible. A company where talent, data and AI turn ideas into hits at a pace no one else can match. And a company that wins with speed, excellence and candor.

To get there, we partner with studios and develop our own games, powered by Homa Lab, our proprietary platform. Homa Lab gives developers the market intelligence, data tools and AI-built game tech to find product-market fit fast and turn mass-market games into lasting hits. Every launch feeds data back into the next, so each turn of the loop is faster, smarter and more likely to win. So far, that's 80+ titles, 2 billion+ downloads, and All in Hole in the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

Our teams are small, talent-dense and light on hierarchy: 160+ people from 30+ nationalities, from the world's best studios and tech companies. AI runs through everything we do. We've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare and Spotify.

For an ambitious, curious, humble, and focused person, Homa is a place to learn, make an impact, and grow their career faster than anywhere else. That's our promise.

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We're building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the "why" behind the "what" - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don't settle for "good enough," - we use common sense to reach higher.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we've designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you're working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we'd love to hear from you!

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
Paid Ads Specialist (Google Ads)

  • Location: American Fork, Utah

  • Schedule: Full-time, In Office (No Remote), Monday-Friday

About DentalQore

DentalQore is a dental marketing company based in American Fork, Utah. We partner with dental practices across the country to help them grow through digital marketing, including websites, SEO, paid advertising, and other patient acquisition strategies.

Our team works closely with practice owners to understand their goals, strengthen their online presence, and turn their marketing investment into measurable growth.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Google Ads specialist to manage paid search for multiple practices, from the first onboarding call through campaign launch, optimization, and client reporting.

You’ll help practice owners decide what to promote, build campaigns around the patients they want to reach, and explain what their ad spend is producing. We need someone who can take ownership of live accounts, spot problems early, and tell clients what we’re doing next in plain language.

This role is a good fit for someone who takes pride in doing thorough, accurate work and following through on commitments. You stay organized across multiple accounts, catch details others might miss, and take initiative when something needs attention. When a problem comes up, you investigate it, communicate clearly, and see it through to a resolution.

What you’ll do

  • Lead PPC onboarding calls to understand each practice’s goals, priority services, target area, and budget.

  • Build, launch, and optimize Google Ads campaigns. Own keywords, negative keywords, ad copy, location targeting, bidding, and budget pacing.

  • Verify call and form tracking before launch. Work with our website and Performance teams when landing pages or tracking need attention.

  • Monitor spend, lead volume, cost per lead, and lead quality. Investigate performance changes, disapproved ads, and tracking issues. Evaluate Google’s recommendations before applying them.

  • Prepare client reports in Swydo, explain what changed and why, and recommend next steps. Work with practices to understand which leads turn into new patients where that data is available.

  • Keep account notes, review dates, and open issues current so the team can see what’s due and who owns it.

  • Review campaigns carefully before launch, checking budgets, targeting, ad copy, landing pages, and conversion tracking for accuracy.

  • Maintain a consistent account review routine, identify issues and opportunities early, and document the actions taken and next steps.

  • Take ownership of open issues and client commitments. Follow up with the people involved, communicate delays or roadblocks, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Help Sales and Client Success set realistic expectations about when paid search is a good fit, what budget makes sense, and how success will be measured.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 2 years of hands-on Google Ads Search experience, including responsibility for multiple active accounts and budgets.

  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting conversion tracking for calls and forms. Familiarity with GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ability to explain campaign results and tradeoffs clearly to clients who don’t work in marketing.

  • A strong work ethic and attention to detail. You manage your time well, meet commitments, check your work, and follow through without needing frequent reminders. When priorities compete, you communicate what needs attention and keep work moving.

Nice to have

  • Agency experience or work with dental practices, healthcare, or other local businesses.

  • Experience with Google Ads Manager Accounts, Swydo or similar reporting tools, and call tracking platforms.

  • Google Ads Search certification.

Why Join DentalQore?

This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact on the success of DentalQore’s clients through paid search.

You’ll take ownership of Google Ads campaigns from onboarding through launch, optimization, and reporting, helping dental practices connect with the patients they want to reach. You’ll have the opportunity to dig into performance, identify issues and opportunities, and make thoughtful decisions about how to improve results.

You’ll also work closely with clients and internal teams to turn campaign data into clear, actionable next steps. If you enjoy managing paid search, solving problems, working with data, and seeing the direct impact of your work, this role gives you the opportunity to take real ownership of both campaign performance and the client experience.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health benefits

  • Life insurance and supplemental benefits

  • 401(k) with company match

  • PTO and paid holidays

  • Employee engagement events and incentives

Perks & Culture

  • Onsite gym

  • Corporate passes for, Sundance Mountain Ski Resort, including ZipTours

Fully stocked breakroom with:

  • Coca-Cola Freestyle machine with free soda

  • Two De’Longhi espresso machines

  • Video arcade

  • Snacks

  • Occasional complimentary lunches

Thank you for your interest in DentalQore. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Refrigeration Technician
description:
We are seeking a seasoned Commercial Refrigeration Technician with at least 8 years of hands-on field experience to diagnose, repair, and maintain commercial kitchen refrigeration equipment. In this senior-level role, you will work independently across restaurants, hotels, institutional kitchens, and grocery facilities to minimize equipment downtime and keep critical cold-storage systems operating at peak efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Diagnostics & Repair: Troubleshoot, repair, and overhaul complex commercial refrigeration systems, including walk-in coolers and freezers, reach-in refrigerators, prep tables, blast chillers, undercounter units, and commercial ice machines.
  • Component Replacement: Perform brazing, evacuation, charging, and leak detection; replace compressors, evaporators, condensers, TXVs, defrost timers, fan motors, and electronic control boards.
  • Preventative Maintenance: Execute scheduled preventative maintenance inspections, coil cleanings, refrigerant pressure checks, and gasket/door hardware replacements to extend equipment lifespan.
  • Compliance & Safety: Handle, recover, and document all refrigerants in strict compliance with EPA Section 608 regulations and local environmental/safety codes.
  • Customer Communication & Documentation: Communicate repair diagnoses, timelines, and cost estimates clearly to kitchen managers and facility directors; maintain accurate digital service logs, parts usage, and timecards.
  • Mentorship & On-Call Rotation: Provide technical guidance to junior technicians as needed and participate in a rotating weekend/after-hours emergency on-call schedule.

Required Qualifications:
  • Experience: Minimum of 8 years of full-time experience servicing and repairing commercial kitchen refrigeration equipment.
  • Certification: Active EPA Section 608 Universal Certification (or Type I & II minimum; Universal strongly preferred).
  • Technical Expertise: Deep proficiency in reading electrical schematics, refrigeration piping diagrams, and diagnosing single-phase and three-phase electrical systems, VFDs, and digital controllers.
  • Driver’s License: Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record insurable under company policy.
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to lift/move up to 75 lbs, climb ladders, work in tight mechanical spaces, and operate in varying temperature environments (from hot commercial kitchens to sub-zero freezers).

Preferred Qualifications:
  • CFESA (Commercial Food Equipment Service Association) Refrigeration Certification.
  • Manufacturer-specific factory training (e.g., True, Traulsen, Manitowoc, Hoshizaki, Scotsman, Kolpak, Heatcraft).
  • Experience servicing commercial hot-side kitchen equipment (ovens, fryers, steamers) is a plus.

Benefits & Perks:
  • Company-dispatched service vehicle, fuel card, and mobile tablet/phone.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, and annual tool/boot allowance.
  • Ongoing paid factory training and certification renewals.

description:
Grand Canyon BU - Region 05 - Market 04: 4702 E Speedway Blvd, Tucson, Arizona 85711

Availability - Shift/Days

Flexible Availability



Minimum Qualifications

The minimum qualifications for a Store Manager are:

  • High School diploma or GED preferred.
  • Experience in retail sales preferred.
  • Experience to perform the essential duties, responsibilities and working in the conditions described below.
  • Ability to supervise and train for the use of equipment, tools and materials listed in the Customer Service Representative (CSR) and Assistant Site Manager (ASM) job description.
  • Ability to supervise and manage the functions listed in the CSR and ASM job description.
  • Ability to use computer, or acquire those skills necessary to use a computer at the site, which includes analysis of reports, inventory control, cash control, counseling notices, etc.
  • A valid driver’s license and adequate transportation to/from bank and corporate management meetings.
  • Ability to communicate (orally and in writing) in English.
  • Perform other duties as assigned or delegated by his/her supervisor.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND SKILLS

Leadership and Management

  • Recruit, hire and train positive, enthusiastic employees, ensuring excellent customer service.
  • Develop, manage and assign tasks appropriately to ensure the site is clean, adequately stocked, organize and well kept based on Company standards.
  • Maintain a professional and supportive image among subordinates and supervisor.
  • Schedule employees within Company guidelines to maximize customer service and maintain site image.
  • Implement non-discriminatory related management skills while hiring, training, counseling, motivating and separating employees.

Site Relationships

  • Develop positive and professional relationships with all suppliers.
  • Promote excellent service and resolve customer complaints in a timely, professional manner.
  • Promote and ensure a safe, positive public image within the neighboring community.

Training and Development

  • Prepare on-going and timely performance appraisals in writing for all employees, providing proper performance based feedback.
  • Train all employees ensuring that customer service, site image and marketing execution meet Company standards.
  • Train all employees on safety procedures and promote safety awareness.

Communication

  • Develop ways and means to ensure that all employees receive proper communication in a timely manner.
  • Establish periodic on-going communication meetings with all site employees and the Market Manager.

Organizing and Planning

  • Evaluate and develop specific action plans to address the needs of the site in order to reach the desired objectives.
  • Organize and maintain all site files and manuals.
  • Manage and supervise store employees to ensure that all required and requested reports due are completed accurately and timely.
  • Manage and supervise store employees to ensure that all merchandise is stocked, attractively displayed and priced correctly.
  • Ensure that all required employment related posters and signs are in a place that is easily accessible to all employees.

Financial

  • Analyze daily sales and expense information and take appropriate action to maximize sales and net profits.
  • Budget and forecast P&L lines, as well as understand and manage merchandise margins.
  • Safeguard and account for all money received and disbursed.
  • Perform all other financial analysis necessary to maximize sales and net profits.

Working Conditions

  • Performs approximately all work indoors but will be required to work outside in order to clean parking lots, gas pumps, take out garbage, etc.
  • Be exposed to occasional cold temperature extremes while supervising or managing store employees performing occasional work in a walk-in cooler and/or freezer.
  • Be exposed to occasional noise.
  • Work with a minimum of direction and supervision.
  • At all times work as an effective manager, supervisor and leader.

title: Facility Assistant
description:
Ben jij een echte aanpakker, heb je oog voor detail en zorg je er graag voor dat alles op rolletjes loopt? Vind je het leuk om collega's te ontzorgen en bij te dragen aan een prettige werkomgeving? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Jouw rol

In een goed georganiseerd en representatief kantoor speelt een sterke facilitaire dienstverlening een grote rol. Als Facility Assistant speel ben jij daarin een onmisbare schakel. Samen met je collega ben je verantwoordelijk voor de facilitaire ondersteuning van onze vestigingen in Breda, Rotterdam, Amsterdam en Eindhoven. Ieder van jullie heeft twee vestigingen als aandachtsgebied. Daarnaast kunnen ook onze vestigingen in Luxemburg en Brussel waar nodig op jullie ondersteuning rekenen.

Je zorgt ervoor dat onze kantoren goed functioneren en collega's kunnen werken in een prettige en veilige omgeving. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen organiseren, administratieve werkzaamheden en praktisch aanpakken. Daarbij neem je initiatief, werk je zelfstandig en weet je ook bij onverwachte verzoeken de juiste prioriteiten te stellen.

Je rapporteert aan de Head of Business Services.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor uiteenlopende facilitaire werkzaamheden, waaronder:

  • Kantoorbeheer: Je zorgt voor een representatieve kantooromgeving, verzorgde werkplekken en vergaderruimten en beheert de voorraad kantoorartikelen;

  • Facilitaire ondersteuning: Je coördineert interne verhuizingen, ondersteunt bij de inrichting van werkplekken en verzorgt de ontvangst en distributie van goederen;

  • Onderhoud: Je signaleert en verhelpt kleine storingen, schakelt leveranciers in en bewaakt de opvolging van facilitaire meldingen;

  • Archiefbeheer: Je beheert het archief, verzorgt de archivering van dossiers en denkt mee over verbeteringen;

  • BHV en veiligheid: Je maakt deel uit van het BHV-team, vervult de rol van ploegleider en organiseert de jaarlijkse ontruimingsoefeningen;

  • Daarnaast behandel je facilitaire vragen en verzoeken via de algemene mailbox en Topdesk.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent servicegericht, praktisch ingesteld en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen. Je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, denkt in oplossingen en neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid. Je kunt goed zelfstandig werken, maar bent ook een echte teamspeler.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Mbo-werk- en denkniveau en enige relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur binnen de facilitaire of zakelijke dienstverlening.

  • Praktisch en technisch inzicht en affiniteit met facilitaire werkzaamheden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Basiskennis van MS Office en ervaring met digitale systemen. Kennis van Topdesk en Aderant is een pré.

  • Een geldig BHV-diploma en diploma Ploegleider BHV.

  • Flexibiliteit en de bereidheid om tussen verschillende vestigingen te reizen.

Wie zijn wij?
AKD is een full-service Benelux-kantoor met ruim 600 advocaten, fiscalisten, notarissen, business- en officesupport collega’s in Nederland, België en Luxemburg.

Wat biedt AKD jou?

Een afwisselende rol binnen een ambitieus team met een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring (bandbreedte: €2587,00 tot €3346,00 bruto per maand op basis van een full time (40 uur/week) dienstverband), aanvullend met goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals:

  • 27 vakantiedagen en een uitgebreid mobiliteitsplan

  • iPhone en laptop

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

Vanaf jouw eerste werkdag kun je aan de slag met een opleidingsprogramma dat je zelf kunt samenstellen.

Diversiteit en inclusiviteit

AKD is een kantoor dat veel waarde hecht aan diversiteit en inclusie en vinden het belangrijk om onze talenten te laten groeien.


Het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (op basis van het juridisch screeningsprofiel) maakt deel uit van de procedure.

title: Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our 3rd year Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap designed to show you first-hand what it’s like to be part of a pharmacy team while gaining an overview of store, district, and regional operations. You will gain valuable hands-on experience through a training roadmap that includes a combination of Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), activities, and time spent with leaders in your district. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

3rd year Pharmacy Interns are responsible for completion of a comprehensive training roadmap, focusing on KLEs that build aptitude in the following areas. As tenure increases, 3rd year Pharmacy Interns take on increasing responsibility of the safety and effectiveness of operations in the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the 3rd year Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Accepted into, or actively enrolled in, an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • ; Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, pharmacy interns should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:


$20.00 - $23.75


Whether in our pharmacies or through our health service offerings, we are pioneering a bold new approach to total health care. As health care innovators, we are making quality care affordable, accessible, simple and seamless. We await your fresh ideas, new perspectives, and the unique contributions you will make to our organization.

title: Construction Planning and Control Technician
description:
This job advert was originally written in Spanish.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Minimum education: Higher Vocational Training (FP) in Administration and Finance, Administrative Management, or similar.

  • Proficiency in planning and monitoring tools, especially Monday or similar.

  • Knowledge of economic control, budgets, certifications, and reporting.

  • Ability for organization, planning, team coordination, and incident resolution.

Nice to have

  • University degrees or higher education in Administration, Industrial Organization, Project Management, or related areas will also be valued.

  • Experience in planning, coordination, and monitoring of works or projects will be valued.

  • Experience in energy rehabilitation is highly valued

Pay & benefits

What you'll get

What we offer

  • Joining a leading company in energy efficiency, with continuous growth in the energy sector
  • Participation in innovative energy rehabilitation projects
  • Professional development and ongoing training
  • Competitive salary package based on experience

The role

Grupo Remica, an important leading company in energy services and energy efficiency management, needs to hire in Madrid:

We are looking for a Works Planning and Control Technician to join the operations team, specializing in the management and monitoring of installation works for thermostatic valves and heating cost allocators in residential buildings.

The selected person will be responsible for the comprehensive planning, coordination, and monitoring of activities, ensuring compliance with established deadlines, budgets, and quality standards, as well as the correct execution of the works.

What you'll do

  • Works planning and monitoring

    • Preparation and updating of execution schedules using tools such as Monday.

    • Planning of installation activities for valves and cost allocators.

    • Monitoring of works progress and control of deadline compliance.

    • Identification of deviations and proposal of corrective measures.

  • Economic works control

    • Monitoring of costs against budget.

    • Control and review of certifications.

    • Analysis of economic deviations and monitoring of activity profitability.

  • Operational coordination

    • Coordination with site managers, foremen, installers, and technical teams.

    • Organization and monitoring of installation teams.

    • Coordination of the various execution phases of the works.

    • Resolution and monitoring of incidents during the development of the works.

  • Execution and quality control

    • Supervision of the progress of thermostatic valve and cost allocator installations.

    • Monitoring of compliance with quality procedures and standards.

    • Verification of the correct execution of the works.

  • Documentary control and reporting

    • Management and updating of works documentation.

    • Preparation of monitoring reports and activity indicators.

    • Periodic reporting to management on the status of works, deadlines, costs, and incidents.

    • Support in the improvement and implementation of operating procedures.

Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years in works planning and/or control
  • Experience in HVAC or installation projects

Technical knowledge

  • Proficiency in planning tools (Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Monday)
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems (air source heat pumps, VRV/VRF, ventilation, etc.)
  • Project cost control
  • Knowledge of regulations (CTE, RITE)

Skills

  • Analytical skills
  • Organization and planning skills
  • Proactivity and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills

About Remica

Remica is a Spanish engineering and services company specializing in HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) installations, industrial piping, and energy efficiency solutions. With a strong presence in the construction and maintenance sectors, the company handles projects ranging from thermal installations to boiler rooms and building services. They operate across Spain, with a significant base in Madrid, and are part of Grupo Remica, which also includes related industrial services.

For international professionals, Remica offers opportunities in technical and trades roles such as refrigeration, welding, plumbing, and HVAC maintenance, as well as engineering and project management positions. The company emphasizes practical, hands-on work and is involved in large-scale installations and maintenance contracts. While the work culture is rooted in Spanish industrial practices, the company is open to hiring skilled professionals who can contribute to their ongoing projects across the country.

title: SAP Business Transformation & Delivery Lead
description:
About the role

With the aim of developing a center of excellence in the Energy&Utilities market and supporting international development, we are looking for professionals in Spain with proven experience in the world of SAP Business Transformation & Delivery Lead

We are looking for a senior profile with a deep knowledge of the SAP ecosystem and, especially, the business processes associated with the Finance and HR areas, capable of acting as a link between the functional business areas and the technical teams.

What you'll do

  • Business & IT Alignment: act as the main interlocutor between the business areas (Finance and HR) and the technical teams, ensuring a common understanding of needs, priorities, and objectives.
  • Business Process Understanding: comprehend business processes transversally, especially in the Finance and Human Resources areas, identifying opportunities for improvement, optimization, and transformation.
  • SAP Functional Oversight: provide a global and functional vision of the SAP ecosystem, understanding its capabilities, modules, and business implications, without the need to have a configuration or technical development profile.
  • Stakeholder Management: manage relationships with stakeholders at different levels of the organization, facilitating decision-making and aligning expectations between the different areas.
  • Project & Delivery Governance: supervise and coordinate initiatives related to SAP and process transformation, ensuring compliance with objectives, deadlines, scope, and quality.
  • Requirements Translation: transform business needs into functional requirements and facilitate their correct interpretation and execution by the technical teams.
  • Change & Transformation Management: accompany the organization in the evolution of its processes and operating models, driving the adoption of solutions and new ways of working.
  • Continuous Improvement: identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement in the interaction between business and technology, promoting a vision of continuous evolution.

What we're looking for

  • Senior experience in business transformation projects, implementation, or evolution of SAP solutions.
  • Solid knowledge of the SAP ecosystem and its application in complex business environments.
  • Transversal vision of business processes, especially in Finance and, preferably, HR.
  • Ability to understand the business beyond the technological tool itself.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary teams, both functional and technical.
  • Ability to translate business needs into solutions and functional requirements.
  • Experience in managing projects, programs, or IT services, as well as in governance and delivery models.
  • Excellent communication, interlocution, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Leadership, influence, and conflict resolution capacity in environments with multiple interlocutors.

What you'll get

  • Innovative and dynamic projects in the SAP field for clients in the Utilities sector.
  • Possibility of growth by building solid professionalism.
  • Challenges and roles of ever-increasing responsibility.
  • Opportunity to work in a hybrid modality.

About the company & team

Lutech One Oberia is the new international digital services and solutions company part of Grupo Lutech, with competencies strongly rooted in the Digital Transformation market.

Lutech is a leader in digital services with vertical know-how in SAP Business Platform, Cloud Solutions, Digital Twin, Big Data and High Performance Computing, Cybersecurity, Customer Engagement Analytics, CRM and Hyper Automation.

It enjoys solid experience and is present in all sectors, with special leadership in the Energy & Utilities and Telco & Media sectors.

title: Director of Memory Care Programs (Senior Living)
description:
About Discovery Management Group

Discovery Management Group leads one of the nation’s most purpose-driven and people-centered senior living organizations, managing and enhancing senior living communities across the United States. With a focus on operational excellence, lifestyle personalization, and culture-driven leadership, we proudly serve residents and families with more than 15,000 units nationwide and growing.

As part of one of the largest senior living families in the U.S., our communities have earned Great Place to Work® certifications from 2022–2027. At Discovery Management Group, purpose guides our work, culture fuels our success, and growth defines our future. We continually aspire and invest in learning and development opportunities that support our team members’ professional growth, ensuring every team member has the tools to build a meaningful and rewarding career.

Discover Your Purpose with Us at Discovery Village at Naples - AL

As Director of Memory Care, you’ll play an essential role in enriching the lives of seniors, creating meaningful connections, and making a difference every single day.

Your Role:

As the Director of Memory Care, your role includes leading our dementia and memory care program to ensure residents receive compassionate, individualized care and engagement. You will oversee program development, compliance, and team leadership while creating a safe, supportive, and life-enriching environment.

Position Highlights:

  • Status: FULL TIME
  • Schedule: Traditional leadership workweek with flexibility required based on business and operational needs that includes Manager on Duty hours as well as on call for emergency situations
  • Location: Naples, FL
  • Rate of Pay: $67k plus 10% Annual Performance Target Bonus

Why You'll Love This Community:

Welcome to Discovery Village Naples, a trusted destination for Independent Living, Assisted Living and SHINE® Memory Care. Our resort-style community features gourmet Culinary Dining, a state-of-the-art Dimensions Health and Fitness Center, an indoor therapy pool, heated outdoor pool and cabanas, Silver Cinema movie theatre, and concierge transportation. Located just minutes from Gulf-coast beaches and upscale shopping in Naples, Florida, we deliver modern amenities, compassionate support, and a lifestyle rooted in connection and independence.

What You’ll Do:

  • Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of the Memory Care program
  • Design and implement dementia-specific programming, including Life Skills and individualized engagement
  • Partner with Activities and Celebrations teams to deliver meaningful daily experiences
  • Supervise, train, and support care staff, ensuring compassionate and compliant service delivery
  • Lead and coach care managers in best practices for dementia care
  • Facilitate monthly family support groups and serve as a family liaison
  • Collaborate with Health & Wellness to align care plans with clinical needs
  • Monitor compliance with all state, local, and federal dementia care regulations; prepare for audits and inspections
  • Manage department budgets, staffing, and performance standards
  • Serve as the community champion for dementia education and awareness

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum 1 year of management experience in dementia/memory care
  • Supervisory experience managing CNAs and/or care staff
  • Knowledge of dementia care regulations and compliance standards
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings or weekends as needed
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with electronic care or scheduling systems preferred
  • Compassionate, resident-centered approach with a passion for serving individuals with dementia

Why Join Us

Discovery Senior Living Earned Coveted Great Place to Work Certification for 2025-2027!

A large part of what makes Discovery different from other companies in this industry is our willingness to embrace change. At Discovery Senior Living, we are constantly challenging how we are doing things to ensure the lifestyle we are offering our residents is absolutely the greatest value proposition in the marketplace. It’s just as important to us that the environment and culture for our team members are constantly refreshed. In addition, embracing and even encouraging change brings a never-ending supply of new energy to our business and our culture. That energy translates to other far-reaching positive impacts on our residents as well as our team members.

Find out what makes working at Discovery unique in the world of senior living. Discover Your Purpose!

Our Culture & Values

So often, what brings people together is deeply rooted in who we are and what we stand for. And at Discovery Senior Living, we’re unified by certain, core values, which we call our “Pillars of Excellence.” They make up the fabric of our company, and include TEAMWORK, INTEGRITY, PERFORMANCE, ACCOUNTABILITY, COMPASSION, HARD WORK and CREATIVITY.

Individually, they are our virtues, and together, they make up a roadmap which helps us foster innovation and success.

Benefits You’ll Enjoy

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive pay, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, a 401(k) with employer match, paid training and career growth opportunities, wellness-related benefits, and additional support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. EOE D/V

A Note to Applicants

This job description outlines the general nature and level of responsibilities for this role and is not an exhaustive list of all duties. Qualified individuals with disabilities, as defined by the ADA, must be able to perform the essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation, as determined on a case-by-case basis.

Agency Policy

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies. Please refrain from contacting hiring managers directly.

Employment Scam Warning

We only post jobs on our official careers site and accept applications through that platform. We do not conduct interviews via text or social media or ask for personal or banking information.

Regulatory Compliance & Background Screening

Discovery Senior Living complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulatory requirements governing hiring practices, background screening, and workforce eligibility. Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of state-mandated and/or federally required background screenings, which may include criminal history checks, fingerprint-based screening, Level 2 background screening, registry verification, and other screenings required for healthcare and senior living roles with direct or indirect resident access.

Certain positions may be subject to additional requirements under federal programs, including CMS, Medicare, and Medicaid regulations, as well as state-specific licensing or regulatory agencies. Screening requirements vary by role and jurisdiction, and candidates must meet all applicable standards as a condition of employment. These measures support regulatory compliance and help maintain a safe, secure environment for residents, families, and team members.

Employment in Florida is contingent upon completion of a Level 2 background screening in accordance with Florida AHCA requirements. Applicants will be required to complete fingerprinting and background screening through the AHCA Clearinghouse. For more information, please visit: .

Job Description:

Title: Senior Staff Scrum Master


Summary

The Senior Staff Scrum Master will play a critical role in enabling Agile delivery across Platform Infrastructure and Enablement by coordinating complex infrastructure initiatives, removing impediments, managing risks and dependencies, and driving predictable execution across product, engineering, operations, and shared services teams. This role requires strong Agile leadership, infrastructure domain understanding, stakeholder management, and a continuous improvement mindset to support resilient, scalable, and secure enterprise platform delivery.

What you’ll discover

  • Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities
  • Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe, Australia and India, click here to learn more.
  • Challenging, collaborative, and team-based environment

What you’ll do

The Platform Infrastructure and Enablement (PIE) organization is responsible for delivering, operating, and continuously improving the foundational infrastructure platforms that enable TJX applications and enterprise services. PIE provides resilient, scalable, and secure infrastructure capabilities across data centers, cloud environments, and distribution centers, forming the core platform layer on which application teams build and run solutions.

As a Senior Staff Scrum Master, your core responsibilities will include:

  • Managing the flow of work throughout the tower, helping teams clear obstacles, manage risks, resolve issues, and deliver on commitments.
  • Working closely with the Product, Delivery, and Engineering teams.
  • Planning, coordinating, and executing production deployments for large epics and initiatives that span multiple product and shared services teams.

What you’ll need

We seek creative, customer-focused individuals with technical knowledge and a mindset for continuous improvement that have significant experience working with Agile Methodology and Software Development Lifecycle and leading moderate to complex assignments. Individuals must have significant experience working with Product Requirements, Solution Design and stakeholder management.

Advanced knowledge in Lean Agile Mindset, excellent communication skills and influencing skills combined with paradoxical & Agile Thinking


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in technology delivery, including 7+ years’ operating in Agile environments as a Program Manager, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Technical Delivery Lead utilizing Scrum and SAFe frameworks.
  • Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master or Program Manager supporting Infrastructure & Operations initiatives, including cloud, platform, database, middleware, network, and data center programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and track delivery of infrastructure projects, releases, migrations, upgrades, patching activities, and production deployments using Agile and enterprise delivery tools.
  • Experience establishing and reporting delivery metrics, operational KPIs, flow metrics, and program health indicators to measure team performance and drive continuous improvement.
  • Experience managing or working within Infrastructure & Operations teams, particularly in Mainframe, database, and hosting environments.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies, including networking, compute, storage, databases, backup and recovery, monitoring, scheduling, middleware, and cloud platforms.
  • Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and supporting ART planning, readiness activities, dependency management, and cross-team coordination across multiple infrastructure workstreams.
  • Expertise in Kanban practices, flow optimization, and Flow Board management to improve predictability and throughput for operational and infrastructure teams.
  • Proven ability to identify, manage, and escalate risks, issues, blockers, and technical dependencies while driving timely resolution across engineering and support organizations.
  • Experience collaborating with infrastructure engineers, architects, operations teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise delivery and operational processes, leveraging tools such as Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, ServiceNow, and Power BI to drive transparency, governance, and execution.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure change management, release management, incident management, and production readiness activities within regulated enterprise environments.
  • Ability to influence outcomes beyond the immediate team by driving process improvements, standardization, and operational efficiencies across teams, programs, and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  • Proven track record of mentoring Scrum Masters, facilitating Communities of Practice, and promoting Agile best practices across the organization.
  • Strong customer-focus and service-oriented mindset with the ability to balance delivery commitments, operational stability, and business priorities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical and delivery status to engineers, leadership, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting multiple teams or complex infrastructure portfolios while maintaining delivery alignment, operational excellence, and organizational objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven expertise leading Agile delivery across Infrastructure & Operations programs, including platform modernization, cloud adoption, operating system upgrades, database refreshes, network initiatives, and large-scale migration efforts.
  • Strong experience facilitating Scrum and SAFe ceremonies at both team and ART levels, including Sprint Planning, PI Planning, Release Planning, Inspect & Adapt, and Scrum of Scrums.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multiple cross-functional teams delivering concurrent releases, infrastructure migrations, production deployments, and operational initiatives while maintaining alignment with portfolio and release objectives.
  • Experience partnering with Infrastructure Engineering, Security, Mainframe, Platform, and Operations teams to manage, prioritize, and track work across multiple initiatives and dependencies.
  • Strong infrastructure domain knowledge including AIX, SQL Server, Oracle Cloud, virtualization, storage, networking, backup and recovery, monitoring, scheduling, and platform lifecycle management.
  • Solid understanding of network and security concepts, including firewalls, load balancing, Zero Trust architecture, vulnerability management, and micro-segmentation.
  • Proven ability to establish and monitor delivery, flow, operational, and quality metrics, leveraging data-driven insights to improve predictability, team performance, and delivery outcomes.
  • Experience leveraging Agile and enterprise tools including Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, ServiceNow, Mural, and Power BI to drive governance, transparency, reporting, and execution.
  • Strong understanding of Solution Delivery Lifecycle (SDLC), DevSecOps practices, SDP controls, change management, release management, and operational readiness processes.
  • Demonstrated success managing risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations while proactively driving resolution across teams and leadership stakeholders.
  • Ability to protect teams from external disruptions, improve flow efficiency, support ART readiness activities, and optimize Kanban and Agile delivery practices.
  • Proven experience fostering high-performing teams through coaching, mentoring, conflict resolution, and servant leadership, including mentoring less experienced Scrum Masters and leading Communities of Practice.

title: Salesperson
description:
Job Description

What is a Salesperson?

Entry level sales position capable of supporting the DIY business and achieve our sales and service objectives. The role has good knowledge of store systems, basic automotive system knowledge and basic part knowledge. The role has the basic ability to source from stores, hubs, pdq, and external suppliers. The role has in-depth knowledge of the store inventory and maintenance processes. Position can be part time or full time. Fleet safety certification preferred.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent selling experience for DIY customer visits and phone calls
  • Achieve personal sales goal and help store achieve its sales goals
  • Provide DIY services including battery installation, testing, wiper installs, etc.
  • Maintain store product and operational standards
  • Responsible for inventory processes including truck put away, shoot outs, cycle counts, Back stock, etc.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Store Cleanliness including floors, bathrooms, facing, dusting, parking lot
  • General stocking including truck stocking and back stock
  • Safely deliver parts to customers as needed

Success Factors

  • Basic driving and navigation ability
  • Ability to use delivery board system
  • Friendly communication
  • Ability to locate and stock parts
  • Safety knowledge and skills
  • Operating inventory systems and store equipment
  • Parts and automotive system knowledge skills
  • Operating POS and Parts lookup systems
  • Expert at testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY service

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a Salesperson

  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and management
  • Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, parts catalogs, and procedure manuals
  • Use basic math accurately: add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
  • Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed

Prior Experience that Sets a Salesperson up for Success

  • 2-3 years of successful sales experience in a diverse retail environment, providing superior customer experiences

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Health is everything. At CVS Health, colleagues are committed to increasing access, lowering costs, and improving quality of care. Millions of times a day, we help people on their path to better health –from advising on prescriptions to helping manage chronic and specialty conditions. As a 3rd year pharmacy intern, you have a significant role in our company working as a part of the pharmacy team– delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients.

While working as a 3rd year pharmacy intern, under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist, you play a critical role in ensuring a safe and effective Retail Pharmacy work environment that delivers exceptional care to each patient. This includes but is not limited to:

  • Customer Service

  • Lead with Heart – display empathy and compassion for your patients, customers, caregivers, and colleagues on your team
  • Seek new ways to grow, collaborate with others, and deliver better outcomes
  • Align others around our purpose to bring your heart to every moment of your health and gain support and commitment
  • Facilitate a team culture that promotes caring, energy, enthusiasm, and pride

  • Accepted into or actively enrolled in an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy

  • Accepted into or actively enrolled in an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
  • 0-3 years relevant work experience

  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Complete all required training within state guidelines and required timeframe
  • Ability to:
    • Have regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Finger Dexterity: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Reach overhead; able to stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Precision control: able to adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree and requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Visual Acuity: Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Able to orally communicate information and instructions to colleagues and customers
    • Occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs; exerting up to 20 lbs. of force occasionally and/or up to 10 lbs. of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects

Ability To:

  • Have regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Complete any additional tasks as directed by supervisor or manager
  • Complete all required training and obtain required licensure (if applicable) within state guidelines

  • Immunization eligibility

title: SAP EWM/WM Lead Implementation
description:
Role: SAP EWM/WM Lead Implementation


• Start Date: Immediate

• Contract Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension

• Work Model: 100% remote

• Working Hours: 9h00 to 18h00 (BRT)
